APPROVE
The `||` short-circuit and definite-assignment-when-false keep the original control flow, and the three helpers reproduce the old logic exactly while moving the nested branches out of the loop, so complexity drops well under 15; I couldn't see the declarations above line 93 or build the project, so this assumes `resolved` really is a `Dictionary<string, string>` and `direct` really is a `List<string>` (if `direct` is a `HashSet<string>`, which deduplicating subspec roots would suggest, the helper signature won't compile).
